source: Z. Song, S. Yue, 'Bounded Gaps Between Primes: An Upper Bound of 236', IACR ePrint 2026/1893, version dated 2 Sep 2026, Appendix A, Table 2 (pp. 51-75)
extraction: pdfplumber character positions; superscript exponents detected by font size (q^r = r copies of part q). Checks: 1295 rows numbered 1..1295 consecutively, every alpha nondecreasing, max a+|alpha| = 25 (paper: a+|alpha| <= 25), no unparsed table line.
meaning: P(z) = sum_rows c * (26/25 - s(z))^a * m_alpha(z) (monomial symmetric polynomial m_alpha, m_empty = 1); P_U(t) = P(26 t/(25 U)), U = 521/2000; F = P_U 1_T in k = 48 variables (paper Eq. (70)).

params.caps: B_0 = 0, B_m = B for m >= 1; T = {t >= 0 : s(t) < U, sum_{t_i > delta} t_i <= B_{r(t)}}
params.criterion: 48 J(F) / I0 > 2001/2000 with I0 = cap-free mass on {s < U} (I_T <= I0); J uses base cutoff s(x) <= L and the capped fibre
